signal.confirmation: completed close strictly outside prior range and volume strictly above reference mean times 1.2
signal.context_filters: none; live safety gates never overridden

stop: opposite edge of prior 20-bar range, fixed at signal time

execution.entry: first following minute open with adverse slippage and adverse tick rounding
execution.exit: stop/target market trigger; adverse slippage and tick rounding; open fills for gaps; stop first for ambiguous intraminute collisions
execution.exit_timestamp: intraminute exit recorded at exit-minute end with interval bounds; gaps at minute open; timeout at exact deadline
execution.late_signal: skip unless full maximum timeout fits partition; no censored final trades

position.quantity: floor notional/entry to native contract quantity precision; fixed notional without compounding
position.capital: independent USD equity per group; no portfolio aggregation or collateral conversion model

fee_assumption: Both fills taker. Public current contract-linked base tier, not verified account entitlement or historical tier. Higher fee case is sensitivity, not assigned account tier.
funding: reported historical absolute fundingRate USD per native base unit per hour; accrue rate at timestamp over following hour, prorated to holding duration; positive rate costs LONG and credits SHORT. Timestamp/accrual convention is a modeling assumption, not verified exchange accounting.
walk_forward: expanding historical context, three successive seven-day evaluation windows after first seven days; fixed parameters and no refitting
out_of_sample_limit: retrospective chronological splits, no tuning; final week was previously inspected in candidate research and is not a pristine untouched holdout
